Animal Health & Hydro ™

With three branches, one located on the East Rand, one in Pretoria East and the other in Little Falls Roodepoort, we specialise in the Physical Rehabilitation of dogs and cats. Our small animal services include Canine Hydrotherapy, Feline Hydrotherapy, Veterinary Acupuncture, Light Therapy, Thermotherapy, Cryotherapy, Massage and many other options. Visit our website to find out more. www.ahah.co.za

We are owned and run by qualified veterinarian Dr Tanya Grantham.
